rowSemanticsEvidence.quote: Jaehrlicher Endenergieverbrauch in Wien nach Energietraegern in GWh

proposal.perimeter: The kept row covers Vienna (NUTS3 AT130, district code 90001) for the single calendar year 2024, giving the ELECTRICITY carrier's share of final energy consumption as restated under the 2024 methodology (REF_YEAR=2024). It leaves out all other energy carriers (gas, oil, district heat, etc.), any breakdown by sector (covered instead by the separate 'Elektrische Energie nach Sektoren Wien' file), and any distinction between gross consumption and net/final consumption.
proposal.openQuestion: Whether this ELECTRICITY column, defined as one carrier within 'Endenergieverbrauch nach Energietraegern' (final energy consumption by energy carrier), is the same quantity as 'annual electricity consumption of the territory' asked for, or whether the sector-based file (Source 2) or a different aggregation is the intended measure, is not decided here.

citations.quote: Jaehrlicher Endenergieverbrauch in Wien nach Energietraegern in GWh

Both files carry a UNIT column. Both carry a REF_YEAR column: the whole series is restated on the methodology of the reference year, so a file published in a later year is not line by line identical to this one.

proposal.perimeter: The kept row is the one whose YEAR column equals 2024, drawn from the file 'Elektrische Energie nach Sektoren Wien' (electricity by sector for Vienna, NUTS3 AT130). It gives, for that single year, five sector-level electricity totals - AGRICULTURE, C_P_SERVICES (commerce and public services), INDUSTRY, RESIDENTIAL and TRANSPORT - each already expressed in GWh per the UNIT column. Adding the five sector columns for that one row gives the territory's total electricity consumption for 2024 as restated under the 2024 methodology (REF_YEAR=2024). The file does not cover any sector outside these five, and does not distinguish sub-district detail (SUB_DISTRICT_CODE is uniformly 0).
proposal.openQuestion: Whether summing the five sector columns (AGRICULTURE + C_P_SERVICES + INDUSTRY + RESIDENTIAL + TRANSPORT) is the correct way to obtain the territory's total electricity consumption, or whether the publisher intends some other aggregation or exclusion (e.g. transport electricity might already be counted elsewhere) is not stated in the material and is left to the requester.
